title: Arkret Cross-Cell Domain Conflict
description: Typed diagnostic for an explicitly registered cross-Cell domain inconsistency. Ordinary causal_register Cells always select a deterministic winner and never produce Bottom. Rejected transitions, missing dependencies, unauthorized inputs, schema failures and security decisions are separate outcomes.

kind.description: The explicitly registered cross-Cell domain rule found an inconsistent combination of otherwise resolved ordinary values. This is not a causal_register join outcome.

cell_ids.description: Exact ordinary Cell ids whose individually resolved winners participate in the registered cross-Cell inconsistency. Security Cells are forbidden.

heads.description: Diagnostic source candidates sorted by complete typed event_id bytes and unique by event_id. The registered domain rule, not a generic register merge, defines why this complete set is inconsistent.

escalated_at.description: When the registered cross-Cell inconsistency first crossed Realm.bottom_escalation_after_ms. Absent when within the grace window. Implementations SHOULD raise an out-of-band notification to admins / recovery governance once set.
